set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
mkdir -p "$base/normalized"
awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 "\t" $2 }' "$base/encodings.tsv" |
while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read name encoding; do
  decoded="$base/normalized/.${name}.decoded.$$"
  output="$base/normalized/.${name}.output.$$"
  rm -f "$decoded" "$output"
  if iconv -f "$encoding" -t UTF-8 "$base/incoming/$name" > "$decoded"; then
    perl -pe 's/\r\n?/\n/g' "$decoded" > "$output"
    mv -f "$output" "$base/normalized/$name"
    rm -f "$decoded"
    printf 'PUBLISHED %s (%s -> UTF-8, LF)\n' "$name" "$encoding"
  else
    rm -f "$decoded" "$output" "$base/normalized/$name"
    printf 'ERROR %s: undecodable as %s; no output published\n' "$name" "$encoding" >&2
  fi
done
find "$base/normalized" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort

command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
printf '%s\n' '--- published set ---'
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort
[ -f normalized/western.txt ]
[ -f normalized/utf8.txt ]
[ ! -e normalized/invalid.txt ]
[ "$(find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]
printf '%s\n' '--- strict UTF-8 validation ---'
for f in normalized/*; do iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$f" >/dev/null; printf 'VALID_UTF8 %s\n' "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- exact normalized bytes ---'
for f in normalized/*; do printf 'FILE %s\n' "$f"; od -An -tx1 -v "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- CR byte check ---'
if grep -l "$(printf '\r')" normalized/*; then exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'NO_CR_BYTES'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- final-byte state ---'
for f in incoming/* normalized/*; do printf '%s last=' "$f"; tail -c 1 "$f" | od -An -tx1; done
printf '%s\n' '--- source checksums unchanged ---'
md5sum encodings.tsv incoming/*
